title: University library Saturday closing time
content: The university library is open from 09:00 until 18:00 on Saturday. The closing time may change during holidays.

title: Research consent form retention period
content: Signed research consent forms must be retained securely for five years after the study finishes.

title: Seminar room booking process
content: Staff can request a seminar room booking through the facilities portal. A booking is confirmed by email.

title: Staff rail travel reimbursement receipts
content: Standard-class rail travel can be reimbursed. Staff must attach a receipt to every travel claim above GBP 10.

title: Student account password reset
content: A student can reset an account password through the identity portal. Photo identification is required at the desk.

title: Research data backup schedule
content: Active research data is backed up every night. A weekly recovery check verifies that the backup can be restored.

title: Wheelchair access at West Hall
content: West Hall has wheelchair access through the ground-floor east entrance and a lift to every teaching floor.

title: AI safety seminar date
content: The AI safety seminar takes place on 22 September at 14:00 in Lecture Theatre 3.

title: Python tutorial recommended version
content: The tutorial examples use Python 3.12. That version is recommended so outputs match the worksheets.

title: Laptop equipment loan duration
content: A standard laptop equipment loan lasts 14 days and can be renewed once when no reservation is waiting.

title: Colour printing cost
content: Colour printing costs 20 pence per A4 page. Black-and-white printing costs 5 pence per page.

title: Campus emergency phone number
content: Call campus security on extension 94541 in an emergency. From an external phone, use 01524 594541.
